title: When praise becomes suspicious
literal_meaning: Excessive devotion is a thief’s sign.
explanation: Exaggerated displays of devotion or deference can invite suspicion that the speaker wants something. In everyday use the warning can concern flattery, not only religious devotion. The force comes from the deliberately sharp word “thief”; the saying itself is not evidence that a particular admirer is dishonest.
meaning_odia: ଅସାଧାରଣ ଭାବେ ଭକ୍ତି ବା ବିନୟ ଦେଖାଇବା ପଛରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଥାଇପାରେ ବୋଲି ଏହି କଥା ସନ୍ଦେହ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରେ। ଚାଟୁକାରିତାରେ ଭୋଳି ନଯାଇ କାମ ଓ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟକୁ ଦେଖିବା ଏଠାରେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ। ଭକ୍ତି ବା ଭଦ୍ରତା ନିଜେ ଚୋରିର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A stranger showers a shopkeeper with praise and then asks to take goods away without paying. The shopkeeper recalls this saying and checks the request carefully. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: ଭକ୍ତି supplies the outward appearance of reverence, while ଚୋର supplies the hidden motive in the proverb’s contrast. Interpretation depends on the conversation; sincere devotion is not being classified as theft.

title: An answer that reveals too much
odia: ଠାକୁର ଘରେ କିଏ ରେ? ନାଁ ମୁଁ କଦଳୀ ଖାଇନାହିଁ
literal_meaning: Who is in the shrine room? Well, I have not eaten the bananas.
explanation: The question asks who is there, but the answer denies an act nobody mentioned. That unsolicited detail directs attention to the speaker’s possible concern. The humour comes from the mismatch between question and reply; a defensive answer alone does not establish guilt.
meaning_odia: କେବଳ କିଏ ଅଛି ବୋଲି ପଚାରାଗଲା, କିନ୍ତୁ ଉତ୍ତରରେ କଦଳୀ ଖାଇବାର ଅସ୍ୱୀକାର ଆସିଲା। ଯେଉଁ କଥା ପଚରାଯାଇନଥିଲା, ତାହା ନିଜେ ଉଠାଇବାରୁ ମନର ଚିନ୍ତା ପଦାରେ ପଡ଼ିଲା। ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ ସଫେଇର ମଜାକୁ ଏହା ଧରେ; ଏପରି ଉତ୍ତର ଏକାକୀ ଦୋଷର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Asked who used the desk, someone immediately replies that they did not break the pen. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary quotes this dialogue under the connective use of na and explicitly calls it a dhaga. The shrine room and bananas belong to the saying; no actual theft, temple custom or origin story is asserted.

title: Tears that conceal support
odia: ଚୋର ମା ଯଦି କାନ୍ଦେ ଆଖି ମଳିମଳି କାନ୍ଦେ ।
literal_meaning: If the thief’s mother cries, she cries rubbing her eyes.
explanation: The source reads the display of distress as concealed support for a wrongdoer. The charge is complicity behind appearances, not proof that a crying relative is guilty.
meaning_odia: ଦୁଃଖ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରୁଥିବା ଲୋକର ନିଜର ସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତି ଗୋପନ ରହିଛି—ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଏହି ବିରୋଧାଭାସକୁ ଧରେ। ବାହାରର କାନ୍ଦଣା ଓ ଭିତରର ଜାଣିବା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଫାଙ୍କ ଥିଲେ କଥାଟି ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ ହୋଇଉଠେ। କିନ୍ତୁ କାନ୍ଦୁଥିବା ଲୋକ ବା ଅଭିଯୁକ୍ତଙ୍କ ଆତ୍ମୀୟ ହେବା ନିଜେ ଦୋଷର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।

odia: ମୋତେ ମାରନାଁ ମୁଁ ମଲିଣି, ଦୀପ ଲଗେଇ ଦେଖ୍ ପିଠି, ଲାଉ ଚୋର ଭାବ ପାଇଲିଣି

title: A boat needs a river
literal_meaning: What can a boat do when the river dries up?
explanation: A useful boat cannot replace the water it needs. The image invites a distinction between ability and the conditions that make ability useful. When an essential resource disappears, blaming the tool or the person alone may miss the real obstacle. This wider application is an editorial interpretation of the quoted saying.

title: The boat fails midstream
literal_meaning: Worn-out boat, you betrayed me in the middle of the river.
explanation: The boat is addressed as though it had broken a promise. Its failure comes in midstream, where the traveller is already relying on it and cannot simply step back onto the bank. That timing gives the short complaint its force. As an editorial application, it can describe an unreliable tool or arrangement failing at the moment it is most needed. The line supplies a vivid reproach; it does not establish a real accident or give instructions for crossing a river.
meaning_odia: ଡ଼ଙ୍ଗାକୁ ମଣିଷ ପରି ଡାକି କୁହାଯାଉଛି—ତୁ ଠିକ୍ ମଝି ନଈରେ ଦଗା ଦେଲୁ। କୂଳରେ ଥିଲେ ପଛକୁ ଫେରିହେବ; ମଝିରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲା ପରେ ସେହି ଭରସା ଭାଙ୍ଗିବାର କଷ୍ଟ ଅଧିକ। ଦଦରା ଡ଼ଙ୍ଗା ଓ ଦଗାର ଧ୍ୱନିମିଳ ଅଭିଯୋଗକୁ ଆହୁରି ମନେ ରଖାଏ। ଆମର ଆଧୁନିକ ପ୍ରୟୋଗରେ, ଦରକାର ବେଳେ ଅଚଳ ହୋଇଯାଉଥିବା ଉପକରଣ ବା ଭରସାହୀନ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥାକୁ ଏହି ଚିତ୍ରରେ କୁହାଯାଇପାରେ।

title: Resolve and a neighbourhood’s stigma
literal_meaning: If the mind is firm, then a home even in the sex workers’ quarter.
explanation: The contrast makes firmness of mind stand against a stigmatized address. The source defines the quarter but gives no account of its residents’ conduct. Our critical reading separates personal resolve from that inherited suspicion: where someone lives cannot establish their worth. This challenge to the stigma is our response, not a counter-moral supplied by the saying.

title: Noble words and the person behind them
literal_meaning: A noble person’s noble words—or deeds.
explanation: The repeated word links the person with what they say or do. The dictionary gives both words and acts among the headword’s senses. Our reading can hear straightforward appreciation of generosity; the source does not fix an ironic tone or make wealth and rank the measure of nobility. The brief expression leaves the particular act unnamed.
meaning_odia: ମହତ ଶବ୍ଦର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ଲୋକଟି ସହ ତାଙ୍କ କଥା ବା କାମକୁ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଅଭିଧାନ ଶବ୍ଦଟିର ଅର୍ଥରେ ଉଦାର ବାକ୍ୟ ଓ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଉଭୟ ଦିଏ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଉଦାରତାର ସରଳ ପ୍ରଶଂସା ଶୁଣାଯାଇପାରେ; ଉତ୍ସ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗର ସ୍ୱର ସ୍ଥିର କରେନାହିଁ, ଧନ ବା ପଦକୁ ମହତ୍ତ୍ୱର ମାପ ମଧ୍ୟ କରେନାହିଁ। ଛୋଟ କଥାଟି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟର ନାମ ଛାଡ଼ି ଦିଏ।
english_summary: The repetition can praise generous words or conduct without specifying status.
odia_summary: ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତିରେ ଉଦାର କଥା ବା କାମର ପ୍ରଶଂସା ହୋଇପାରେ।

title: The boat of dharma
literal_meaning: The boat of dharma travels happily.
explanation: The entry places the line under following the religious path, then gives the literal boat sense. Its note records a belief that dharma keeps boats afloat. Read as an image of faith, the journey offers reassurance. Our interpretation preserves that confidence as a belief, without turning it into a physical promise of safety.
meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନ ଧର୍ମପଥ ଅନୁସରଣ ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଢଗଟି ରଖି ପରେ ପ୍ରକୃତ ନୌକାର ଅର୍ଥ ଦିଏ। ଟୀକାରେ ଧର୍ମ ଥିବାରୁ ଡଙ୍ଗା ଭାସୁଛି ବୋଲି ଏକ ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଲିପିବଦ୍ଧ। ଆସ୍ଥାର ଛବି ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ିଲେ ଯାତ୍ରାଟି ଆଶ୍ୱାସ ଦିଏ। ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ସେ ଭରସାକୁ ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଭାବେ ରଖେ, ପ୍ରକୃତ ଯାତ୍ରାର ନିରାପତ୍ତା ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି କରେନାହିଁ।
english_summary: A boat image expresses religious confidence, not a safety guarantee.
odia_summary: ଡଙ୍ଗାର ଛବିରେ ଧାର୍ମିକ ଭରସା, ନିରାପତ୍ତାର ନିଶ୍ଚୟତା ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ପଢ଼ାଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ ଢଗଟିକୁ ନିଜ ଆସ୍ଥାର କଥା ଭାବେ କହିଲେ। ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ଏଠି ଡଙ୍ଗାଟି ତୁମ ପାଇଁ କଣ?” ସେ କହିଲେ, “କଠିନ କାମରେ ଭରସା ରଖିବାର ଛବି।” / In a reading group, someone uses the saying to express faith. Asked what the boat means to them, they answer, “An image of keeping confidence through difficult work.” The exchange is invented.
